The five `.feature.md` files are unmodified Cucumber test fixtures from
[testdata/good at a461e39](https://github.com/cucumber/gherkin/tree/a461e39d0e6c05a5757ebad1e759e2a87116679e/testdata/good),
distributed under the accompanying upstream LICENSE. The matcher in
`internal/spec/gherkin_markdown.go` follows the same revision's
[GherkinInMarkdownTokenMatcher](https://github.com/cucumber/gherkin/blob/a461e39d0e6c05a5757ebad1e759e2a87116679e/javascript/src/GherkinInMarkdownTokenMatcher.ts).
